name: send-this
note: The 'send this to' pillar, posts 01 to 04, copy final per the Oct 2026 brief (rendered exactly as written; 01 and 04 run 16 words). Instagram only, one a week, backgrounds alternate cream and green. 03 is the only post with the hairline rule. Reference export: social/reference/design-system/ig-send-this/.

posts.hook: send this to the person who has a full fridge and still orders DoorDash every night
posts.payoff: the food is right there. we built an app for this.
posts.why: Everyone knows the full-fridge DoorDash person; naming them is the share.
posts.app: iEatz writes dinner from what is already in the fridge.

posts.hook: send this to whoever grocery shops on Sunday and orders takeout by Tuesday
posts.payoff: the groceries are still in the fridge. iEatz turns them into dinner.
posts.why: The groceries had a plan and Tuesday did not: the gap the app closes.
posts.app: Add the groceries to iEatz and it writes the week.

posts.hook: send this to whoever spent $60 at Trader Joe's and ate cereal for dinner
posts.why: The Trader Joe's haul that ended in cereal: a shareable confession.
posts.app: Add the haul to iEatz and it writes dinner before the cucumbers go.

posts.hook: send this to whoever opens the fridge, stares for a full minute, and closes it again
posts.payoff: it's not empty. you just can't see dinner yet. iEatz can.
posts.why: The fridge stare is universal; the app is the thing that sees dinner in it.
posts.app: Tell iEatz what is in there and it writes the recipe.
